title: pvMedian
body:
## pvMedian

Replaces each pixel or voxel of an image by the median of the selected array over a rectangular neighbourhood of KernelSize pixels, giving image data of the same size. Unlike a mean filter it removes isolated outliers (salt-and-pepper or shot noise) while keeping sharp edges. Each component is filtered separately. Near the image border the neighbourhood is clipped to the image.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- With the ParaView default kernel [1, 1, 1] nothing changes; set e.g. [3, 3, 1] for a 2-D image or [3, 3, 3] for a volume.
- Even kernel sizes are off-centre and average the two middle values; prefer odd sizes.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `Median`. Identity: `filters/Median`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Median filter. Accepted data: image data (uniform rectilinear grids) (vtkImageData). The input needs at least one point-centred array with 1 component. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkImageData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `KernelSize` | The value of this property specifies the number of pixels/voxels in each dimension to use in computing the median to assign to each pixel/voxel. If the kernel size in a particular dimension is 1, then the median will not be computed in that direction. | `{"items":{"type":"integer"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `SelectInputScalars` | The value of this property lists the name of the scalar array to use in computing the median. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE","REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
